title: ANSQU Vintage Glass Jar with Lid, 23.7oz Airtight Glass Storage Canister Glass Food Storage Containers for Kitchen Counter, Pantry, Decorative Jar for Coffee, Tea, Sugar, Candy Cute Jar
description:
About this item
High-Quality Material: ANSQU glass jar with lid is made of food-grade premium thick glass, good stability, low temperature and high temperature resistance
Airtight Food Jar: The candy jar use bamboo lid and silicone sealing ring for a better airtight space and moisture-resistant environment, dustproof and moisture-proof to keep the food fresh
Vintage Embossed Jar: The appearance of the vintage glass jar adopts the design concept of sunflower embossed, exquisite and beautiful, both decorative and practical performance, suitable as festival decorative glass jar for your family and friends, perfect Mother's Day gift
Perfect Size For Subpackage: Size: 5.51 inch* 3.85 inch (14* 9.8 cm); Capacity: 23.7 Fl oz (700 ml) liquid or 0.55 lbs (250 g) coffee beans; Opening for the Jar: 3 inch (7.5 cm). This size is suitable for a variety of small storage purposes
Versatile Glass Canisters: Perfect to store tea, coffee, sugar, flour, beans, rice, spices and your favourite snacks like cookies, candy, nuts etc. The pantry Jar can be used not only to store items, but also being a stylish adornment for all styles of home decoration
